title: Concentration and Nucleic Acid Extraction of Viruses from Wastewater Influent
author: Ari N Machtinger
materials: Gather the materials and reagents for the Zymo quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit in the Biosafety Cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

Gather the materials and reagents for the Zymo quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit in the Biosafety Cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

steps.title: Add Tween 20 to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of 10 % (v/v) Tween 20 stock solution to each centrifuge tube to achieve a final concentration of 0.1 % (v/v) Tween 20.

steps.title: Handle raw wastewater safely
steps.instruction: Follow the Safety Warnings section; transfer the influent sample from the refrigerator to the fume hood, remove the sample bottle from its secondary container, and unseal the bottle by removing the affixed Parafilm.

steps.title: Aliquot influent and controls
steps.instruction: Invert the influent bottle several times to resuspend contents, then open it. Using a fresh 50 mL serological pipette, dispense 40 mL of influent into each of five 50 mL centrifuge tubes (total 200 mL). For a negative control, dispense 40 mL of 1X PBS into each of two centrifuge tubes (total 80 mL). Limit the volume in each tube to 40 mL to reduce leak risk.

steps.title: Cap, parafilm, and store samples
steps.instruction: Cap and Parafilm all bottles and centrifuge tubes. Return the influent bottle to secondary containment, wipe exposed surfaces with pre‑empt wipes, and place any remaining influent back in refrigeration.

steps.title: Vortex tubes
steps.instruction: Place all centrifuge tubes on a vortexer using a 50 mL tube adapter and vortex at 1000 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Sonicate tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the tubes from the vortexer to a sonication bath and sonicate for 1 minute at 40 kHz. Dry the tubes with a paper towel after sonication.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Transfer the tubes to a centrifuge (e.g., Beckman Coulter Avanti J series with JA‑14.50 rotor) and spin at 10 000 rcf, 4 °C for 5 minutes. After centrifugation, wait 10 minutes for aerosols to settle before opening the rotor, then return the tubes to the fume hood.

steps.title: Start InnovaPrep pipette
steps.instruction: Turn on the InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette Select, navigate to Maintenance → Start‑up, follow the prompts, verify the maintenance tip is installed, place the waste line correctly, remove the storage fluid line, insert the foam elution canister, and confirm the screen reads “WWULTRA”.

steps.title: Assemble vacuum filtration units
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, set up a 0.45 µm vacuum filtration apparatus for each sample and control by attaching a filtration unit to a clean Pyrex bottle. Combine the five influent tubes (~200 mL) into one filtration unit and the two control tubes (~80 mL) into the second unit.

steps.title: Decant supernatant for influent
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the supernatant from each of the five influent tubes directly into the 0.45 µm filtration top attached to the influent collection bottle, taking care not to dislodge the pellet.

steps.title: Vacuum‑filter influent
steps.instruction: Cap the filtration top, open the vacuum line, and run vacuum filtration until all liquid passes. When complete, cap the Pyrex bottle and set it aside.

steps.title: Process negative controls
steps.instruction: Decant both control tubes directly into their 0.45 µm filtration top (no pellet expected), perform vacuum filtration as described for the influent, cap the Pyrex bottle, and set aside.

steps.title: Store nucleic acids at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Place all extracted nucleic acids in a freezer set to –80 °C. Optionally quantify RNA with the Qubit HS RNA assay kit or DNA with the Qubit 1X dsDNA assay kit before freezing.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % Tween 20 stock
steps.instruction: Combine 4 mL Tween 20 with 36 mL 1X PBS to make 40 mL of 10 % (v/v) Tween 20 solution, then filter‑sterilize using a 0.22 µm vacuum filtration unit (sufficient for ~100 treatments).

steps.title: Concentrate influent sample
steps.instruction: Remove the maintenance tip and insert a fresh Ultra CPT tip into the tip port. Lower the tip to the bottom of the influent sample bottle (balance the bottle if needed). Press “Start Run” and allow the pipette to aspirate waste; the run lasts ~17 minutes and ends with a beep when air is detected.

steps.title: Elute foam into tube
steps.instruction: While holding a 5 mL centrifuge tube under the tip, press “Elute” and collect the dispensed foam.

steps.title: Add Zymo shield reagent
steps.instruction: After the foam degasses, add 400 µL Zymo DNA/RNA Shield reagent (1:1 ratio) to the eluate (final volume ≈400 µL).

steps.title: Add Viral DNA/RNA buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 600 µL Viral DNA/RNA buffer (2:1 ratio) to the mixture and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Concentrate negative control
steps.instruction: Repeat the concentration steps (remove tip, insert fresh Ultra CPT tip, start run, elute foam, add 400 µL Zymo Shield, add 1 600 µL Viral DNA/RNA buffer, vortex) for the negative control sample using a fresh tip.

steps.title: Shut down InnovaPrep
steps.instruction: Navigate to Maintenance → Shut Down, place the maintenance tip in the tip port, remove the elution canister, verify adequate storage fluid, insert the storage fluid line, turn off the device, and remove the waste line.

steps.title: Incubate with shield
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples with added Zymo DNA/RNA Shield at room temperature for 30 minutes. If incubation exceeds this time, store the samples at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bind lysate to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of lysate into a Zymo‑Spin IIC‑XLR column in a collection tube, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 2 minutes, and discard the flow‑through. Repeat until the entire lysate volume has been processed.

steps.title: First wash of column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 30 seconds, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second wash of column
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash step with another 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 95‑100 % ethanol to the column and centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute to ensure complete removal of wash buffer.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean collection tube and centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute to eliminate any remaining ethanol.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Transfer the column into a 1.5 mL nuclease‑free tube, add 50 µL DNase/RNase‑Free Water directly to the column matrix, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 30 seconds to collect the eluate.
